summary: Check whether 112/146 is a supplementary attestation

data.question: Is 112/146 intentionally a supplementary attestation of mqaṣqaṣle?

rationale: The quoted plural nḥərre with the ox u tawro matches 44/144 exactly. At 112/146 a single man slaughters a ram (nḥəlle), and mqaṣqaṣle is also present. The automatic “not-found” result therefore does not establish a bad verb attestation, but this verse is not the source of the full quotation. Confirm whether the secondary citation is intentional.
